name: Tjaart van der Walt
profile: South African chemical engineer (PhD, Stellenbosch, 1992) and serial tech entrepreneur. He co-founded AI software firm CSense (sold to GE in 2011), then in June 2012 co-founded Tyme with university friend Coen Jonker; they sold it to Commonwealth Bank of Australia and bought it back in 2018 with ARC. Tyme runs TymeBank (SA) and GoTyme (Philippines).
interesting_fact: In 2026 Stellenbosch University awarded him an honorary Doctor of Engineering as a pioneer of digital banking in Africa.
deep_cut_fact: His doctoral research was on new artificial-intelligence algorithms, and in the 1990s he was an executive director of the Foundation for Research Development (now South Africa's National Research Foundation) and part of the founding team of The Business Bank.

public_contacts.value: Rachel.Freeman@tyme.com (Tyme Group media queries and interview requests)

notes: Also listed as co-founder of RockIT Venture Capital. Lower profile than Coen Jonker.

name: Tian Shan
current_role: Chief Technology Officer, DeepWay (深向科技) (left the board before the 2025 IPO filing; CTO status not confirmed)
profile: Tian Shan (田山) spent 13 years at Baidu, ending as senior manager responsible for autonomous-driving infrastructure R&D and commercial-vehicle deployment. Nominated by Baidu, he joined DeepWay in Sept 2020 as CTO, leading the electric heavy-truck maker's autonomous-driving technology, and sat on its board from June 2022.
interesting_fact: He brought Baidu Apollo's autonomous-driving stack to DeepWay, which holds Apollo's only 'white-box' licence for commercial vehicles.
notes: Rccaijing reports he was removed from the board just before the Nov 2025 HK IPO filing; unclear whether he remains CTO. Verify before outreach. https://m.rccaijing.com/news-7394296639576011829.html?week_id=4216

name: Sara Sargent
current_role: Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer, Solace Health
profile: Sara Sargent co-founded Solace in 2022 with Jeremy Gurewitz; it connects patients with expert healthcare advocates and reached a ~$1B valuation with a $130M IVP-led Series C in Feb 2026. Before Solace she led brand at Synthesis and Literati and worked as an independent creative/brand strategist.
interesting_fact: She has described the original Solace as a marketplace for health advocates; advocates on Solace are former doctors, nurses, pharmacists and other clinicians.
deep_cut_fact: Her background is in brand and content rather than product: she was Head of Brand at Synthesis and Literati and earlier lead content editor at MV3 Marketing.
notes: Low public profile; route via Solace.
